faq.q: How many homes sold in South Surrey and White Rock last month?

blocks.text: New listings in South Surrey and White Rock come on the MLS® every day. This search shows the ones that have been on the market 7 days or less, live. To judge a fresh listing, it helps to know how quickly the market is clearing: in October 2026, 54 detached homes and 81 condos and townhomes sold in South Surrey and White Rock, and the typical detached home sold in 32 days.
How fast South Surrey and White Rock homes sold over the past year

Detached sales in South Surrey and White Rock peaked at 72 in April 2026 and were lowest at 32 in January 2026. Active detached listings moved between 417 and 655 over the same 13 months. In October 2026 the median detached sale price was $1,552,500, which is 13% below October 2025.

blocks.text: How long a new South Surrey and White Rock listing may sit

Months of supply is the number of months it would take to sell today's listings at the current pace. For South Surrey and White Rock detached homes it was 10.6 months in October 2026 and for condos and townhomes 6.9. The fastest detached price ranges were $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 (27% sales ratio on 8 sales); $1,500,001 to $1,750,000 (16% sales ratio on 13 sales); $1,750,001 to $2,000,000 (13% sales ratio on 10 sales). For condos and townhomes the quickest were $600,001 to $700,000 (27%) and $400,001 to $500,000 (19%).

By area, new detached listings met the strongest demand in Sunnyside Park (25%), Pacific Douglas (23%), Crescent Beach Ocean Park (11%). The areas with the most stock relative to sales were Morgan Creek (2%), Grandview (3%), King George Corridor (4%), so a fresh listing there is likely to have company.
South Surrey and White Rock against last year

Compared with October 2025, October 2026 had 5% fewer detached homes for sale in South Surrey and White Rock and 7% fewer detached sales. Condos and townhomes had 17% fewer for sale and 17% fewer sales. The detached sale price moved 13% down and the condo and townhome price 6% down.
